title.en: Ask assistant and create speech audio

titleFormatted.en: Ask assistant [[question]] and speak the answer with voice [[voice]]

hint.en: Asks the AI assistant, then turns its answer into natural speech and gives you a link to the audio (MP3) together with the answer text. No voice device needed — pass the link to a Sonos, Chromecast or any speaker that can play a URL. Leave the voice empty to use the app's voice. The link stays valid for about five minutes, so play it right away rather than storing it.

placeholder.en: Write a cheerful one-sentence announcement that the dishwasher is done.

example.en: The dishwasher is done — time to empty it!
